zoe: Heads-up — QA reported raw emails in logs from the Python sampleapp (uvicorn/gunicorn). Looks like our redactor is only applied to the formatted message but not to record.args when libraries log by passing dicts.

matt: interesting. which logger stack? uvicorn.access + our structlog wrapper?

zoe: structlog 22.1 + python-otel-instrumentation 1.8. Order in app startup: init_otel(), init_reqid_middleware(), init_redactor(), then structlog.configure(). But otel instrumentation wraps the standard logging handler and sometimes emits logs before our redactor hook runs.

olga: paste the example log lines?

zoe: snippet:```
{"timestamp":"2026-05-02T12:03:01Z","level":"debug","reqid":"py-77","event":{"email":"charlie@acme.com","action":"invoke"},"redactor":"skipped"}
2026-05-02T12:03:01Z INFO reqid=py-77 event="user.invoked"
```

matt: I think this is the dict-args path. structlog preserves the event dict which gets encoded by the JSON renderer before our middleware scrub. If otel wraps logging early it can create a Handler that receives the raw LogRecord with args and bypasses structlog processors.

olga: mitigation: add a logging.Filter that sanitizes LogRecord.args/LogRecord._dict_fields as early as possible at the root logger so any handler sees scrubbed content. Also move our redactor initialization to run before otel instrumentation, or make it idempotent and attach as a ProcessLogger wrapper in structlog itself.

sam: strong +1 for root Filter. Also emit a metric redactor_bypass when we detect 'redactor=skipped' in structured output. That helps Optimize alert on regressions.

zoe: opened PR #4502: introduces RedactingFilter applied to logging.getLogger() root, swaps init order so redactor attaches before otel-instrumentation in bootstrap, and adds a small integ test that runs uvicorn under load and asserts no raw email regex in JSON logs. Added repro script at /scripts/py-uvicorn-repro.sh.

matt: add test that simulates a third-party lib calling logging.LoggerAdapter or injecting its own handler to confirm the root Filter is effective.

telemetry-bot: sampleapp/python/staging v0.9.3 -> deploy success :white_check_mark: (build 9174)

olga: QA will run the repro harness and the new integ. If green we should backport the Filter to the 0.8.x branch used by Dedicated customers.

zoe: will add changelog entry and an ops note to set LOG_LEVEL=info if any customer sees debug PII before patch applied. tagging @sam @matt for review.

sam: reviewing now. thanks for the clear repro, zoe.
